hooks.command: bash -c 'path=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path" <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"); if echo "$path" | grep -qE "(^|/)(dist|build|[.]next|node_modules|coverage|target|vendor)/"; then echo "Blocked: edit to generated directory"; exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac'
bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.rs) cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged -- -D warnings 2>/dev/null || true;; esac'
